org.label: Organization
org.timezoneHint: Everyone who has not chosen a zone of their own is measured against this one.
org.defaultLocaleHint: Everyone who has not chosen a language of their own sees this one.

organization.read: Read the organization, its departments, roles and absence types.
organization.manage: Edit those settings, roles and single sign-on included. It is the permission that reaches this screen.

employee.read: Open the people directory and other people's profiles.
employee.manage: Invite, edit and deactivate people, and assign them roles.

attendance.read: See other people's clock-ins and timesheets.
attendance.write: Clock in, clock out and take breaks. Always only for oneself.
attendance.approve: Decide the correction requests that come from the people they manage.

holiday.request: Ask for time off. Always only for oneself.
holiday.approve: Decide the time-off requests that come from the people they manage.

document.read: Open the documents shared with them.
document.write: Upload documents, and edit their own.
document.manage: See, share and delete every document in the organization, whoever it belongs to.

report.read: Open the attendance and absence reports, and export them.

roleSettings.title: Roles
roleSettings.intro: A role is a named bundle of permissions. Nothing in Beacon checks a role by name, so add the roles your organization actually needs instead of stretching a built-in one.
roleSettings.tokenNote: A permission change reaches someone when their session next refreshes, within fifteen minutes.
roleSettings.readOnly: You can see the roles, but changing them needs permission to manage the organization.
roleSettings.name: Role name
roleSettings.noPermissions: This role grants nothing on its own.
roleSettings.builtInName: A built-in role keeps its name, which Beacon translates. Its permissions are yours to change.
roleSettings.ownerLocked: The owner role always holds every permission, so an administrator can never be locked out.
roleSettings.notEditable: This role holds permissions you do not have, so it is not yours to change.
roleSettings.cannotGrant: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot put it in a role.
roleSettings.inUse: {count, plural, one {# person holds this role} other {# people hold this role}}
roleSettings.deleteBlocked: Give those people another role before deleting this one.

profile.editable: You can change your phone number, language and time zone. Everything else is maintained by your organization.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.notConfigured: No provider is configured yet. Fill in the form below and save to create one.
sso.displayNameHint: Shown on the sign-in screen — "Sign in with {example}".
sso.issuerUrlHint: The identity provider's OIDC issuer, e.g. https://your-org.okta.com.
sso.clientSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the secret already stored.
sso.allowedDomainsHint: One per line. Leave empty to allow any domain.
sso.redirectUriHint: Paste this into your identity provider's application configuration.
sso.enabledHint: Offer sign-in through this provider on the login screen.
sso.enforcedHint: Hide the password form for everyone except administrators — who can still use "sign in with a password" if the provider is unreachable.
sso.deleteConfirm: Remove this SSO provider? Anyone who signs in through it will need a password instead, once one is set for them.
